title: Dusk to Neon: The Fade
base_prompt: a solitary young woman with sharp features, long dark coat, short black hair with a silver streak, standing in an empty urban street at transition from day to night, carrying a small mysterious package, cinematic character study, preserve exact face, body type, clothing details, and expression across all shots
character_ancestry_bible: Elena Voss, a 29-year-old woman of primarily recent East African sapiens ancestry with 8% Neanderthal introgression (robust brow ridge contribution, thicker jaw potential, cold-climate skin baseline with high melanin plasticity) + minor Denisovan input in vascular patterning. Face shape: heart-shaped with high forehead, soft taper to chin, prominent cheekbones softened by gracile sapiens traits. Hair: type 4 dense coily black with silver streak in loose low bun, fine micro vellus fuzz on face and upper torso, moderate macro terminal axillary and lower leg hair in natural gradient. Body: tall ectomorphic with long limbs/high crural index (equatorial savanna hominin adaptation), narrow waist, lean athletic upper torso, rounded glutes. Skin: high eumelanin dispersion in basal layers for deep tone; 32% subsurface irradiance refraction with visible faint tiger-stripe melanin patterning (most in raking light on temples, inner arms, collarbones) producing realistic SSS glow and depth calibrated to high-UV ancestry.
continuity_notes: Keep the woman's face, silver streak in hair, coat shape and buttons, the package, and general pose consistent. Use previous output as strong reference image when moving to next style. Only the color grade, grain, lighting mood, and world details should change dramatically with each style. ALWAYS repeat the full character_ancestry_bible block verbatim at the start of every beat's prompt for cross-LUT anatomical lock.

beats.name: The Last Warm Light
beats.narrative_beat: Setup / Ordinary World. Introduce the character and quiet moment before everything changes. Warm, human, vulnerable.
beats.prompt_add: gentle golden hour side light fading, soft wind moving her hair and coat hem, she looks down at the package with quiet curiosity, very subtle handheld feel, filmic breathing, establishing the real world before the fall
beats.transition: slow push in from wide to medium as light starts to cool

beats.name: The Shadow Falls
beats.narrative_beat: Inciting Incident. First hint of the mystery / darker world. The light dies, scholarly/old world mood takes over.
beats.prompt_add: the sky darkens quickly into stormy twilight, long shadows from unseen buildings, she pulls coat tighter, first rain drops, package seems to glow faintly, moody window light from a distant library or old building, increasing tension
beats.transition: match cut on the package + color temperature drop into rich browns and deep greens

beats.name: Rain and Memory
beats.narrative_beat: Rising Action. The world turns dangerous and stylish. Urban noir rain, reflections, the package becomes important.
beats.prompt_add: heavy cold rain, wet pavement reflections of sodium streetlights, she walks with purpose now, coat collar up, neon sign flickers in background reflecting in puddles, cigarette smoke or steam, high contrast, classic detective mood, camera tracks beside her
beats.transition: rain intensifies with a slow dolly move, color shifts to desaturated with red accent on package

beats.name: The Glitch
beats.narrative_beat: Crisis / Midpoint twist. Reality fractures. The street becomes future, tech intrudes, the package reacts.
beats.prompt_add: the world glitches into dense cyberpunk night: holographic kanji and ads flicker over the old buildings, heavy rain + neon magenta/cyan reflections everywhere, the package emits soft digital light and particles, her eyes catch reflections of code, anamorphic flares, she looks around in alarm as the city transforms around her, dynamic handheld + slight push in
beats.transition: aggressive style bleed + digital glitch transition on the package opening slightly

beats.name: The Choice in the Light
beats.narrative_beat: Climax. Big emotional / action beat. High stakes cinematic. She makes the decision with the package.
beats.prompt_add: epic scale even on a single character: dramatic teal shadows, orange rim light from a giant unseen light source or explosion in distance, wind and rain whipping dramatically, she holds the package up to the light, intense close-up to wide heroic framing, anamorphic lens flares, high contrast blockbuster energy, determination on her face
beats.transition: big swell, color punch into teal-orange, slow motion elements on rain and hair

beats.name: After the Neon
beats.narrative_beat: Resolution / New Equilibrium. After the storm, a strange peace or bittersweet new reality. Warm but changed.
beats.prompt_add: the storm passes, first warm golden light breaks through the clouds and neon haze, steam rises, she stands alone in the middle of the now-quiet street, package is open or transformed subtly, soft glowing backlight wraps her, gentle wind, a single tear or small smile, resolution with lingering questions, very soft romantic drama color and focus, final slow push or crane up as credits feel
beats.transition: long cross dissolve + color temperature warming, last neon reflections fade to gold

beats.name: The Package Remains
beats.narrative_beat: Final image / stinger. Memory / aftermath. Slight aged film print feeling.
beats.prompt_add: final static or very slow push on her silhouette against the now calm street, the package on the wet ground or in her hands, faded vintage 35mm print look, slight film weave and grain, one last warm highlight, the feeling that this has all happened before or will happen again, quiet poetic close
beats.transition: fade to the aged print look, hold on final frame

audio_notes: Native Imagine video audio: start with soft rain + distant city hum + subtle emotional piano or strings (warm acoustic in first beats). Build tension with low synth drone and increasing rain intensity + distant thunder in crisis/climax. Neon section gets electronic pulse + distorted radio chatter. Resolution returns to warm acoustic guitar + rain softening. Final tag almost silent with only very distant city and soft reverb. Voiceover optional: the woman whispering one line at the package in the last beat.
notes: Example of flowing one character through many visual styles while telling a complete mini story arc. Use strong image reference chaining for face/coat/package consistency. Generate each beat's video clip individually then concat with crossfades in post (or ask Grok to help assemble).
